verdict.rationale: RevenueCat can be driven without its dashboard. It has a REST API authenticated with secret server-side keys for sensitive actions and server-side imports, and an MCP server that manages apps, Products and Entitlements without using the dashboard. However, nothing documents CI usage, a CLI, or a headless automation workflow, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration, an official CLI or non-interactive automation guide, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: there are various endpoints that can be used for refunding purchases, granting promotional entitlements, and other sensitive actions that can only be done via a Secret API key from your server.
The RevenueCat MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enables AI assistants to manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and everything in-between without using the RevenueCat dashboard.
A server side import involves sending all of the Apple receipts and/or purchase tokens to RevenueCat via the `POST /receipts` REST API endpoint.
